summary: Build ISO 22301 BCMS skills with practical BIAs, recovery planning, audits, and reporting. Book advanced training today.
lede: Business continuity management covers how continuity, risk, operations and audit professionals assess critical activities and plan recovery. Participants learn to build a business impact analysis and dependency map, select continuity strategies, and develop response plans, exercises and audit evidence aligned with ISO 22301, along with reporting and improvement methods for ongoing BCMS review.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with continuity, risk, operations, audit, or crisis response and now need to strengthen ISO 22301 application, evidence, and governance.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: working knowledge of organizational operations, risk management, or service delivery; familiarity with continuity plans or incident response processes is helpful. You should be comfortable reading policy, process maps, and operational metrics, but you do not need to code. The advanced concepts in this course are taught at an operational-to-implementation level, with hands-on work focused on BCMS scope, BIA outputs, recovery strategies, exercise design, and ISO 22301 clause mapping.
